title: Unbounded operator
description: Linear operator defined on a dense linear subspace
extract: In mathematics, more specifically functional analysis and operator theory, the notion of unbounded operator provides an abstract framework for dealing with differential operators, unbounded observables in quantum mechanics, and other cases.
